title: Balancing equality for action maps
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], B and C sheaves of commutative O_Y-algebras [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf], phi:B to C an O_Y-algebra morphism, and P a sheaf of B-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Put P0=P restricted to O_Y, S=C.toModule tensor_O P0, F=B.toModule tensor_O S, and T=(C tensor_B P) restricted to O_Y [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let tau be the canonical tensor-section map and eta the change-of-rings presheaf sheafification unit [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. For any O_Y-module morphisms a,d:F to S and g:S to T satisfying a_W(tau(b,tau(c,p)))=tau(c,bp), d_W(tau(b,tau(c,p)))=tau(phi_W(b)c,p), and g_W(tau(c,p))=eta_W(c tensor_B p) for every open W, b in B(W), c in C(W), and p in P(W) [lem-weil-pbc-change-of-rings-tensor-action-maps-core], a followed by g equals d followed by g.

source.place: Morphisms, proof of Lemma 01SB (morphisms-lemma-affine-equivalence-modules), change of rings assertion; Sheaves, Lemma 0089 (sheaves-lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules); explicit tensor-balancing argument in steps 1-4 of lem-weil-pbc-change-of-rings-tensor-relation-presentation

proof.text: Cancel the tensor sheafification isomorphism and use injectivity of the sheafification adjunction hom-equivalence. Tensor extensionality then determines a morphism on pure tensor sections. For the right-associated triple tensor, locally lift the inner tensor section through its locally surjective tensorator, induct on the resulting tensor using additivity, and use separatedness of the target to descend equality. This is the fully proved private tensor_right_triple_hom_ext in the Lean module.

On b tensor (c tensor p), rewrite by the three hypotheses. The two results are the images under the change-of-rings unit of c tensor_B bp and phi(b)c tensor_B p. TensorProduct.tmul_smul identifies them using the B-action on C induced by phi.

theorem changeOfRings_tensor_action_comp_eq (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (B C : Y.CommAlgebraSheaf) (φ : B ⟶ C)
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B.right))
    (a d : tensorObj B.toModule (tensorObj C.toModule
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P)) ⟶
      tensorObj C.toModule ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P))
    (g : tensorObj C.toModule ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P) ⟶
      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 C.hom)).obj
        (SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} φ.right P))
    (h : ChangeOfRingsTensorActionFormulas Y B C φ P a d g) :
    a ≫ g = d ≫ g
